name: Between Father and Son
description: In just a few suspenseful minutes, a lawyer's world tilts as her visit to her fiancé's family estate ignites an irresistible bond with her future stepson.

videos.title: Here / Now
videos.overview: Bárbara meets her fiancé's family for the first time and discovers everyone is hiding a secret, including her.

videos.title: Forbidden Goddess
videos.overview: A family dinner destroys everyone's appetite. Tension between Álvaro and Bárbara gives Iker what he needs.

videos.title: The Stepson
videos.overview: Tequila, gossip and conflicting stories lead Bárbara further into a family mystery.

videos.title: Rebirth
videos.overview: Álvaro encouraged Iker to bond with Bárbara, but not to this extent. Exploring Fernanda's room breeds conflict.

videos.title: The Scent of Your Skin
videos.overview: Confronting Iker seems right until forbidden desires take over — and Álvaro's suspicions alight.

videos.title: Playing With Fire
videos.overview: The ultimate faux pas sets Margarita on the warpath. Álvaro's nightmare reveals a frightening declaration.

videos.title: 21 Hours in Paris
videos.overview: Bárbara's sure she's getting closer to the truth. She won't get it, though, if Gaby has anything to say about it.

videos.title: Modesty
videos.overview: An intimate scene in the woods and an ultimatum push Bárbara away from Iker. A slip of the tongue yields a new clue.

videos.title: Forbidden Dawn
videos.overview: Passion fuels Iker and Bárbara, and a mistake rings alarm bells for Luna. Gaby's façade begins to fracture.

videos.title: A Decent Man
videos.overview: A dead woman's plans come to light, as three living women plot to derail an engagement.

videos.title: Storm of Desire
videos.overview: Alcohol isn't the only vice in the Sarmiento family. Bárbara digs deeper into Fernanda's past.

videos.title: Truth After the Rain
videos.overview: A dense fog threatens Iker's life, as Luna divulges Bárbara's secret to a dangerous enemy.

videos.title: Painful Memories
videos.overview: Álvaro gets disturbing information concerning Iker. A strange call leads to a terrible outcome.

videos.title: The Intruder
videos.overview: A murder puts everyone on edge. An intimate moment between Bárbara and Iker is marred.

videos.title: The Walls Have Eyes
videos.overview: Luna threatens Iker and forces Bárbara's hand. A dire warning comes from the grave.

videos.title: Calligraphy
videos.overview: A letter, a text message and a lie sow chaos among the Sarmientos. Margarita's poison sinks deep.

videos.title: The Unexpected Visitor
videos.overview: An unexpected guest pushes Gaby to her limits. As Bárbara digs for more intel, more bodies start piling up.

videos.title: The Price of Hatred
videos.overview: Police questioning catches Álvaro in a lie, just as Bárbara's lucky streak runs out.

videos.title: Voluntary Absence
videos.overview: In a divided household, it's Iker's turn to ask questions, but everyone is hell-bent on burying their secrets.

videos.title: From the Depths
videos.overview: In a house of horrors, Bárbara comes face to face with its ghosts. A family reunion ends in blood.
